EnvironmentSecretProviderConfig.description: The environment secret provider. It takes no settings.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

root.description:
Absolute directory holding one file per secret. Each file must be a
regular file owned by the runtime user, mode 0400 or 0600, with exactly
one hard link.

SecretProvidersConfig.description:
The secret providers a runtime enables. A reference is resolved only by a
provider declared here: `secret:file/name` under `file.root`, and
`secret:env/NAME` only when `environment: {}` is present.

environment.description:
Enables `secret:env/NAME` references, read from the process
environment. Declared as an empty mapping: `environment: {}`.

file.description: Enables `secret:file/name` references, read from files under `root`.

SecretReference.description: An exact secret reference: secret:file/name, resolved under secretProviders.file.root, or secret:env/NAME, resolved only when secretProviders.environment is declared.

assertionKeyRef.description:
The client's private assertion key, one JWK, as a secret reference
a provider under `secretProviders` resolves.

resource.description:
The resource the approved grant is exchanged for: an absolute URI
without a fragment or user information.

scopes.description:
The scope ceiling requested with the grant: 1 to 32 distinct OAuth
scope tokens, each at most 128 bytes and without `*`.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host, no user information, and no whitespace or control character.

description:
A task connection file: the Casework target, the issuer that exchanges
tokens for it, and the clients registered to acquire grants.

bootstrapResource.description:
The resource of the bootstrap token that asks Casework for a grant
assertion: an absolute URI without a fragment or user information.

caseworkUrl.description:
The Casework base URL a grant assertion is requested from: `https`,
or `http` to 127.0.0.1, localhost, or [::1]; no query or fragment.

clientAssertionAudience.description:
The audience of each client's private_key_jwt assertion: an absolute
URI without a fragment or user information.

clients.description:
The registered clients, by client id: 1 to 32. A client id is 1 to
64 lowercase letters, digits, or `-`, since it also names the header
file a grant is written to.

secretProviders.description: The providers that resolve each client's `assertionKeyRef`.

tokenEndpoint.description:
The OAuth token endpoint each client authenticates to with
private_key_jwt: `https`, or `http` to 127.0.0.1, localhost, or
[::1]; no query or fragment.
